nuggets.text: Lincoln Kienholz became the first Louisville quarterback to throw for 300 yards in his debut, going for 307 against Ole Miss.
Lincoln Kienholz is the first Cardinal since Lamar Jackson in 2017 to pass for 300 and run for 50 against a ranked team.
Ohio State coach Ryan Day called Cardinals QB Lincoln Kienholz a four-handicap golfer who can also windmill dunk.
The Cardinals erased a 14-point deficit in the final 6:43 to tie No. 9 Ole Miss before falling 41-38 on a game-ending field goal.
Cardinals coach Jeff Brohm was born in Louisville and played quarterback for the Cardinals from 1989 to 1993.
Jeff Brohm's father, Oscar, was also a Louisville quarterback, and his brother Greg was a Cardinals receiver.
Before coaching the Cardinals, Jeff Brohm was a first-team All-XFL quarterback for the Orlando Rage in 2001.
The Cardinals' stadium sits on an old rail yard, and the yard's original shift horn blasts every time Louisville scores.
The Cardinals have not lost to a lower-division team since Division I-AA Marshall beat them 34-31 in 1987.
Under Jeff Brohm, the Cardinals are 3-0 against FCS teams, winning by a combined 169-17.
